evidence.snippet: this.db = openDatabase({ name: this.DB_NAME, version: this.DB_VERSION, ... })
evidence.why: Opens a plain unencrypted react-native-sqlite-storage database with no encryption (e.g. no SQLCipher key) to store PII.

evidence.snippet: email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, phone_number TEXT NOT NULL
evidence.why: Email and phone number (PII) are persisted in cleartext columns in an unencrypted on-device database.
